phytomer.t: n. [植]植物繁殖单位(如植物茎上的节等)

phytometer.t: 植物计, 植物蒸腾表

phytomonic acid.t: [化] 乳杆酸; 乳酸杆菌酸; 11,12-亚甲基十九酸; 11,12-亚甲基十九碳酸

phyton.t: n. 植物机构单位； 植物繁殖单位
phyton.d:
n. One of the parts which by their repetition make up a
   flowering plant, each being a single joint of a stem with its leaf or
   leaves; a phytomer.

phytonadione.t: n. [化]植物甲萘醌,维生素K&-{1}(用作凝血药)
phytonadione.d: n a form of vitamin K

phytonomy.d: n. The science of the origin and growth of plants.

phytons.t: n. 植物繁殖单位；植物结构单位

phytopaleontology.t: n. [古生]植物化石学,古植物学

phytopathologist.d: n. One skilled in diseases of plants.

phytopathology.d: n. The science of diseases to which plants are liable.

phytophaga.d: n. pl. A division of Hymenoptera; the sawflies.

phytophagic.t: a. [动物学]食植物的, 食叶类的, 食草的

phytophagous.t: a. (昆虫)食植(物)的, 食叶类的

phytosanitary.t: a. 植物检疫的,控制植物(尤指农作物)病害的

phytosociological.t: a. phytosociology（植物社会学）的变形

phytosphingosine.t: 植物鞘氨醇, 4-羟双氢(神经)鞘氨醇

phytosterin.t:
[化] 植物甾醇
[医] 植物甾醇(旧名)

phytotherapy.t:
n. 植物治疗法, 本草疗法
[医] 植物[药]疗法
phytotherapy.d: n. the use of plants or plant extracts for medicinal purposes (especially plants that are not part of the normal diet)

phytotomy.d: n. The dissection of plants; vegetable anatomy.

phytotoxin.d: n any substance produced by plants that is similar in its properties to extracellular bacterial toxin

phytotoxin tests.t: [医] 植物毒素试验, 马克特氏试验(检血液病)

phytoxylin.t: [医] 植木胶(一种类似火棉胶的物质)

phytozoon.d:
n. A plantlike animal. The term is sometimes applied to
   zoophytes.
